findings: Compared the exact local candidate README with v7.2.9. The STEP4 model and quality, availability-based initial selection, generated credit example, API pricing and A4 description match the candidate. The original sample remains attributed to 2.5. Future v7.3.0 release asset is labeled available only after release; the verified public v7.2.9 link remains available. Candidate uses a temporary-index tree; the release gate still requires a matching committed HEAD and actual API acceptance.
manualFindings: The 12-page Gemini, 19-page OpenAI and 40-page full PDFs were compared page by page to v7.2.9 by text and rendered pixels. The Gemini cover changed its version; OpenAI pages 10, 12 and 19 update verification, the model to allow and the official link. Full manual pages 18 and 22 update the image credit and STEP4 settings. Visually inspected all six affected body pages. Built-in privacy, A4, text bounds, link and version checks passed.

pricingReview.findings: The official GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst Standard list is $8/$2 cached image input, $30 image output and $5/$1.25 cached text input per million. This is a list of token rates, not a per-image bill. Existing 2.5 and Gemini standard rates remain; Batch prices are separate, and the 2.0 price stays labeled as an October 23 reference.
